hypotheses.title: Major-pair nested logistic vs random walk
hypotheses.hypothesis: A locked lagged-return logistic selected on development origins 1-108 of six ECB euro pairs has strictly lower cost-adjusted MAE than a random-walk forecast on the same expanding walk-forward outer folds. Origin 109 stays frozen.
hypotheses.holdout: Development origins 1–108; origin 109 frozen. Source: ECB statistics.

hypotheses.title: Leakage-safe ridge/logistic vs random walk
hypotheses.hypothesis: Leakage-safe nested ridge or multi-feature logistic on six ECB euro pairs has strictly lower cost-adjusted MAE than a random-walk forecast on development origins 1-108. Origin 109 stays frozen.
hypotheses.holdout: Development origins 1–108; origin 109 frozen. Source: ECB statistics.

hypotheses.title: Carry, momentum, and regime filter vs random walk
hypotheses.hypothesis: Pre-registered carry, 21-day momentum, or a vol-regime filter of those signals has strictly lower cost-adjusted MAE than a random-walk forecast on six ECB euro pairs, development origins 1-108, using BIS policy-rate carry. Origin 109 stays frozen.
hypotheses.holdout: Development origins 1–108; origin 109 frozen. Source: ECB statistics.

hypotheses.title: 5-day reversal and turn-of-month vs random walk
hypotheses.hypothesis: A 5-day reversal, turn-of-month overlay, or reversal that skips turn-of-month has strictly lower cost-adjusted MAE than a random-walk forecast on six ECB euro pairs, development origins 1-108. Origin 109 stays frozen.
hypotheses.holdout: Development origins 1–108; origin 109 frozen. Source: ECB statistics.

hypotheses.title: HAR-RV vs GARCH vs EWMA vs naive 1-day RV
hypotheses.hypothesis: HAR-RV has strictly lower QLIKE than naive last RV and is included in the pair-count QLIKE model-confidence set (at least 4 of 6 ECB euro pairs) for 1-day close-to-close realized variance on development origins 1-108. Origin 109 stays frozen.
hypotheses.holdout: Development origins 1–108; origin 109 frozen. Source: ECB statistics.
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED. HAR-RV has the best pooled QLIKE but is not in the pair-count MCS (2/6). EWMA alone is in the MCS. EURCHF is a composition effect. Robust finding unsupported. Not a trading edge.
hypotheses.note: HAR-RV has the best pooled QLIKE but is not in the pair-count MCS (2/6). EWMA alone is in the MCS. EURCHF is a composition effect. Robust finding unsupported.

hypotheses.title: Direction-model Gaussian CRPS vs random walk
hypotheses.hypothesis: A Gaussian density around a carry, momentum, regime, reversal, or turn-of-month point forecast has strictly lower mean CRPS than a random-walk density on six ECB euro pairs, development origins 1-108. Origin 109 stays frozen.
hypotheses.holdout: Development origins 1–108; origin 109 frozen. Source: ECB statistics.

hypotheses.title: 1-day 99%/97.5% VaR and ES backtests
hypotheses.hypothesis: At least one of EWMA, HAR-RV, or GARCH(1,1) 1-day Gaussian VaR/ES is statistically adequate at both 99% and 97.5% on all six ECB euro pairs under Kupiec unconditional coverage, Christoffersen conditional coverage, and Acerbi-Szekely Z2 (5%). Origin 109 stays frozen.
hypotheses.holdout: Development origins 1–108; origin 109 frozen. Source: ECB statistics.
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED. EWMA 0/6 pairs at both levels. GARCH 1/6 at 99% and 2/6 at 97.5%. HAR-RV 4/6 at 99% and 2/6 at 97.5%. No model is adequate on all pairs at both levels. Not a trading edge.
hypotheses.note: EWMA 0/6 pairs at both levels. GARCH 1/6 at 99% and 2/6 at 97.5%. HAR-RV 4/6 at 99% and 2/6 at 97.5%. No model is adequate on all pairs at both levels.

hypotheses.title: Weekly and monthly RV: does EWMA MCS inclusion hold?
hypotheses.hypothesis: The 1-day pair-count QLIKE MCS inclusion of EWMA holds at weekly (5-day) and monthly (22-day) average realized-variance horizons on six ECB euro pairs, development origins 1-108. HAR is refit on the h-day target. GARCH uses iterated h-step mean variance. Origin 109 stays frozen.
hypotheses.holdout: Development origins 1–108; origin 109 frozen. Source: ECB statistics.
